name: Industry intelligence
blurb: Signals, patterns and insights about an industry, linked to the products and technologies they concern, with hybrid search over the sources.
about: Build a living intelligence record of an industry, and the agent workflows around it. It keeps signals, the patterns they support or contradict, and the insights drawn from them linked to the products, technologies and companies they concern, and to the sources they came from. Which patterns are gathering evidence, which are contested and which have gone quiet is worked out from the record each time you ask. Agents triage new evidence and propose links on branches that an analyst reviews before they are merged.
